description: Skills derivation engine and certificate PDF generation. Builds the two core automated subsystems: (1) skills derivation that runs after event completion to update MemberSkill levels, and (2) certificate PDF generation via headless Chromium that produces printable PDFs and enables the currently-disabled PDF/Share buttons on the member certificates page. Also installs required packages. Depends on FEAT-001 (schema) and FEAT-003 (completions.ts, issuance.ts must exist). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Read context.json and FEAT-003's findings field before starting. Read src/app/(member)/me/certificates/page.tsx in full — the disabled PDF and Share buttons are the specific UI that gets enabled here.
Read src/lib/credentials/completions.ts (created in FEAT-003) and src/lib/credentials/issuance.ts to understand how ActivityCompletion rows are created before skills derivation runs.

Install packages. Run from workspace root c:\Users\jazai\Downloads\nimeche-platform: npm install idb @vercel/blob @sparticuz/chromium puppeteer-core. Note: @sparticuz/chromium is ~50MB and will extend build times — this is expected and acceptable.

Create src/lib/skills/derivation.ts. Import db from src/lib/db. Export async function deriveMemberSkills(memberId: string): Promise<{ changed: number }>. Implementation: (1) Query all ActivityCompletion rows for this member, joining to ActivitySkill via sourceType+sourceId to get associated skills and whether any had assessment (requiresAssessment flag on the completion rule). (2) Query ProjectMember rows for this member to get project-role skills. (3) For each Skill that appears in the member's activities, compute the new level: if the member's current MemberSkill has level=VERIFIED, do not downgrade it (leave it); else apply rules — >=3 activities OR (>=1 activity AND that activity's completionRule had requiresAssessment=true AND ActivityCompletion exists) → PRACTISING; >=1 activity → INTRODUCED; if member has a ProjectMember row for a project that has an ActivitySkill entry for this skill → COMPETENT (overrides PRACTISING). (4) Upsert MemberSkill rows where the computed level differs from the stored level. (5) For each level change that is an upgrade, create an ActivityEntry row (kind=SKILL_LEVEL_UP, summary='Your [skill name] skill has moved to [level label]'). (6) Return { changed: count of upserted rows }.

Create src/lib/skills/actions.ts. Export server action runSkillsDerivationAction(memberId: string) — 'use server', calls requireRole([EXECUTIVE, ADMIN]) then deriveMemberSkills(memberId). Export server action verifyMemberSkillAction(memberId: string, skillId: string, verifierName: string) — 'use server', calls requireRole([EXECUTIVE, ADMIN]); upserts MemberSkill with level=VERIFIED, verifiedBy=verifierName, verifiedAt=now(); creates ActivityEntry (SKILL_LEVEL_UP); logAudit(CREDENTIAL_ISSUED — reuse this action type; or add SKILL_VERIFIED to AuditAction enum in schema if not already present).

Wire derivation into completions: update src/lib/credentials/completions.ts — at the end of runCompletionEvaluation, after upserting ActivityCompletion rows, call deriveMemberSkills for each member whose completion was just created. Import deriveMemberSkills from src/lib/skills/derivation.ts.

Add skill verification UI to admin member detail: update src/app/(admin)/members/[id]/page.tsx to add a Skills section listing the member's current MemberSkill rows with level chips; for PRACTISING or COMPETENT skills, show a 'Mark as Verified' button that calls verifyMemberSkillAction. Add a verifier name input (the executive's name) alongside the button.

Create src/lib/certificates/template.tsx. This is a React component that renders the certificate as a full HTML document for PDF generation. It uses inline styles only (no Tailwind, no CSS variables — Puppeteer renders a static HTML string without any stylesheet). Props: { memberName, programmeTitle, issuedAt, sessions, contactHours, skills, events, verificationCode, memberNo? }. Layout (A4 landscape, 297x210mm): (1) Left accent bar: 4px wide, full height, background #EE7623 (orange — per design plan the gear rule is the 4px orange rule on credential components). (2) Header band: background #00713A, text white, contains NiMechE crest placeholder (use a small SVG inline — the crest is at assets/nimeche-logo.svg but it's 123KB; for Phase 1, inline a simplified text-based reference: 'NiMechE-SF · Tech-U'). (3) Body: member name large (Sora-like fallback: Georgia or serif for PDF), programme title, 'Certificate of Completion' overline, issued date. (4) Stats row: sessions count, contact hours. (5) Skills list. (6) Events list. (7) Verification section: code in monospace, verification URL. (8) Signatures block: two lines for Executive signatures. This is a Phase 1 template — it will be refined. All colours are hardcoded (not CSS variables) because Puppeteer renders standalone HTML.

Create src/lib/certificates/pdf.ts. Import @sparticuz/chromium/min and puppeteer-core. Import put from @vercel/blob. Export async function generateCertificatePdf(credentialId: string): Promise<string> (returns blob URL). Steps: (1) Query Credential by id, include member (fullName, memberNo), skills (via CredentialSkill->Skill name), events (via CredentialEvent->Event title). (2) Render template.tsx to HTML string: use import { renderToStaticMarkup } from 'react-dom/server' with the credential data as props. Wrap in a full HTML document with <head><style>@page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 0; } body { margin: 0; }</style></head>. (3) Launch Puppeteer: chromium.executablePath() for the path; args from chromium.args; headless: 'new'. (4) Set page content to the HTML string. (5) Print to PDF with { format: 'A4', landscape: true, printBackground: true }. (6) Close browser. (7) Upload PDF buffer to Vercel Blob: put('certificates/' + credentialId + '.pdf', buffer, { access: 'public', contentType: 'application/pdf' }). (8) Update Credential.pdfUrl in DB. (9) Return blob URL. Handle errors: if Chromium fails (missing env, wrong platform), catch and throw a clear error 'PDF generation unavailable in this environment'.

Create src/app/api/certificates/[id]/pdf/route.ts. export async function GET(request, { params }). Auth check: call auth() from src/auth.ts. Get session member id. Query the Credential by params.id — verify it belongs to the session member OR the session member has isAdmin=true; return 401 if not. If Credential.pdfUrl already set, redirect to it (no regeneration). Otherwise call generateCertificatePdf(params.id). On success, redirect to the PDF URL. Set Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400. Handle errors with a 500 JSON response { error: 'PDF generation failed' }.

Enable the PDF button in src/app/(member)/me/certificates/page.tsx: replace the disabled prop on the PDF download button with an anchor tag (<a href={/api/certificates/${credential.id}/pdf} download>). Remove the disabled prop. Keep the Button wrapper for styling. Update the Share button: replace disabled with an onClick handler (client interaction needed — convert the certificates card section to a client component OR use a small 'use client' wrapper component for just the share button). The Share button copies the verify URL to clipboard: navigator.clipboard.writeText(siteUrl('/verify/' + credential.code)). Show a Sonner toast on success: 'Verification link copied'. Import siteUrl from src/lib/env.ts.

Create unit tests. Create src/lib/skills/__tests__/derivation.test.ts: import deriveMemberSkills and mock src/lib/db with vi.mock. Test cases: (1) member with 0 activities gets no MemberSkill changes; (2) member with 1 activity gets INTRODUCED; (3) member with 3 activities gets PRACTISING; (4) member with 1 activity + assessment gets PRACTISING; (5) member with project role gets COMPETENT; (6) existing VERIFIED level is not downgraded. Create src/lib/credentials/__tests__/issuance.test.ts: test generateVerificationCode format (must match /^NM-[A-Z2-9]{4}-[A-Z2-9]{4}$/), test no 0/O/1/I in generated codes.
Run npm run typecheck — fix all errors. Run npm run build — fix all errors. Run npm run test — all tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: deriveMemberSkills correctly assigns INTRODUCED for 1 activity, PRACTISING for 3+ activities, COMPETENT for project roles, and does not downgrade VERIFIED
runCompletionEvaluation triggers deriveMemberSkills after creating ActivityCompletion rows
verifyMemberSkillAction sets VERIFIED level and requires EXECUTIVE/ADMIN role
generateCertificatePdf returns a Vercel Blob URL and updates Credential.pdfUrl
/api/certificates/[id]/pdf requires the credential to belong to the session member
PDF and Share buttons on /me/certificates are no longer disabled
Share button copies the verification URL to clipboard and shows a Sonner toast
npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm run test passes — new skill derivation and code format tests pass
verification: npm run typecheck (must pass with zero errors)
npm run build (must succeed — note: @sparticuz/chromium extends build time)
npm run test (derivation tests and issuance tests must pass)
